title: Deterministic Appearance Compiler / Reference Engine
purpose: Repository-side reference and validation engine; not application runtime.

determinism.canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON, keys sorted, compact separators for hashing

permission_rules: Permission filtering runs before matching, support classification and fallback.
Hidden asset identity and hidden asset counts are never emitted or inferred.
permission_filter_applied reports that the filtering stage ran; it does not reveal whether hidden assets existed.
compatibility_rules: A requested renderer ID must match the manifest renderer ID or the result is explicit unknown coverage with a diagnostic.
A requested asset-pack ID/version must match the manifest identity/version or the result is explicit unknown coverage with a diagnostic.
A nonempty asset_lock permits only the explicitly locked asset IDs; unavailable locked IDs are diagnosed and never silently replaced.
Coverage aggregation matches CAPP-04: all supported is supported, all unsupported is unsupported, all unknown is unknown, and mixed states are partial.
reference_tests: same inputs produce byte-equivalent semantic result
unauthorized assets are filtered without identity/count disclosure
renderer and asset-pack mismatches return explicit diagnostics
missing authorized coverage returns explicit unknown fallback
compiler never mutates Character, biology, or equipment truth
